dedupe_keys.name: field reconnaissance of steel grain bins and agricultural storage after the august 2020 midwest derecho designsafe rapid

description: Post-event survey data on the wind performance of steel grain bins and other farm storage structures after the derecho of 10 August 2020, which caused heavy damage in rural central and eastern Iowa. The DataCite record for this DesignSafe-CI publication, part of the project 'Performance of Agricultural Storage Silos and Farm Bins in Nebraska and Iowa During the August 2020 Derecho', says bins were surveyed with manual measurements, ground photography and aerial imagery, documented with the RApp tool, and that the data cover undamaged and damaged bins in the derecho's path, their design and construction, estimated condition before the event and condition after, with geotagged photographs and aerial images for selected bins. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODC-By-1.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the sample covers bins along the storm path in Iowa and Nebraska, and condition before the event is estimated. For simulation it gives observed damage states for grain storage under extreme wind, to build fragility curves for agricultural storage and assess post-harvest supply losses. Related catalogue records include NHERI DesignSafe wind reconnaissance datasets and the SAEON grain silos dataset for South Africa.
